description: Steer the snake, chain quick eats for combo streaks, and climb levels as the pace ramps up—complete with particles, toasts, and screen shake for big moments. Pick difficulty and board size to match your mood, then chase your best score on a ranked leaderboard. Earn points from play to unlock colorful snake skins and collect sixteen badges across food, score, combo, and milestone goals. app is suitable for all ages
